Ather Rizta S spec sheet

Ather Rizta S specifications
Peak power4.3 kW
Torque22 Nm
0 – 40 km/h4.7 s
Top speed80 km/h
Battery2.7 / 2.9 / 3.5 kWh
IDC range123 km / 161 km
TrueRange100 km / 125 km
Charging (0–100%)7 hr 25 min (450 W) / 4 hr 30 min (900 W, 3.5 kWh)
Fast chargeUp to 15 km in 10 min on Ather Grid
Storage34 L boot + 22 L frunk = 56 L
Kerb weight125 kg
BrakesDisc front 200 mm / drum rear 130 mm, CBS
Dashboard17.7 cm (7") DeepView™ display
NavigationNot available
SeatStandard black, pillion backrest standard
Battery warranty3 yr / 30,000 km standard · extendable up to 10 yr / 1,00,000 km

Best for: Budget-conscious family buyers, and anyone stepping off a 110cc petrol scooter.
